faqs: PawMe is an AI-powered robotic pet companion that autonomously follows your pet from room to room. It uses advanced sensors and machine learning to track their behavior, detect anxiety, monitor health patterns, and provide comfort through interactive features — all controllable from your phone.

Is it safe for my pet?

Absolutely. PawMe is designed with pet safety as the #1 priority. It uses gentle, slow movements, soft-touch materials, and advanced obstacle detection. It's been tested with over 200 pets during development and is vet-approved.
Will it work in my home?

PawMe works in any home with flat flooring. It navigates doorways, hallways, and open floor plans seamlessly. During setup, it maps your home automatically and learns the optimal routes to follow your pet.
What if my pet is scared of it?

Most pets are curious, not scared. PawMe has a gradual introduction mode that lets your pet approach and investigate at their own pace. 94% of pets in our testing program were comfortable with PawMe within 48 hours.
